name: Bikaner Sentinel-2 satellite ground imagery
attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025)
orientation: North is top, east is right. Bounds are west,south,east,north. Pixels are evenly spaced in longitude and latitude.
notes: Actual optical satellite imagery; cloud-free annual composite, not live photography. Downloaded directly as rendered JPEG crops from the public EOX WMS. The service resamples the mosaic to requested pixel dimensions; this does not increase the 10m native spatial detail. No AI generation, sharpening, or invented streets/buildings. Region image is downsampled to approximately16m/px. The imagery is provided under its own license; it is not licensed as original application code.
